title: FoShanShiNanHaiQuNuoAiTongZhuangShangHang Recalls CIYTI Light-Up Princess Costumes Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
hazard: The costumes violate the mandatory safety standard for toys because the button cell batteries can be accessed easily by children, posing a deadly ingestion hazard. If button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, including internal chemical burns, and death.
description: This recall involves CIYTI Light-Up Princess Costumes. The costumes include a blue dress with a crown and wand that light up, and a remote control. The crowns, scepters, and remote controls contain button batteries. There are no markings on the product. The package has "CIYTI" on the front.
remedy: Consumers should take the princess costumes away from children immediately, stop using them and contact FoShanShiNanHaiQuNuoAiTongZhuangShangHang for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALLED" with permanent marker on the dress, crown, wand, and remote, then throw away the toys and submit a photo of the disposed toys to Norakid2026@outlook.com. Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.

title: BAMAMON Recalls LED Projecting Finger Light Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
description: This recall involves Bamamon LED Projecting Finger Light toys which contain three button cells batteries. The finger lights come in 32 pieces in a box in red, orange, blue, black, purple, clear, green and yellow. The finger lights project eight space themed patterns such as astronauts, rockets, UFO, galaxy and solar systems printed on labels located on the front of the package.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the toys immediately and contact Bamamon. Consumers will be asked to email a photograph showing the product being properly disposed of in the trash to bamamonproductrecall@outlook.com.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire
hazard: A vehicle fire increases the risk of injury.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Q4 E-Tron and Q4 Sportback E-Tron vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail and cause a fire.
remedy: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% capacity until the repair has been completed. The remedy is currently under development. Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed December 18, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the remedy is available. Owners may contact Audi customer service at 1-800-253-2834. Audi's number for this recall is 93SK. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 23, 2026.

title: Hobby Sports Equipment: E-Bike
hazard: Fire. The charger plug of the product has an insufficient fuse. If there is a fault with the product, it could overheat and catch fire. There is no valid technical documentation for the product and no evidence of production control. In the absence of evidence to demonstrate the conformity of the product, it may be possible for it to overheat and catch fire.
description: Black electric bicycle with a battery and charger. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Machinery Directive.
remedy: Destruction Of Product; Import Rejected At Border; Removal From Online Marketplace
country: United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland

title: Toys: COOL.TRICYCLES/  Tricycle électrique pour garçons, jouets interactifs éducatifs et créatifs
hazard: Chemical. The screw that secures the battery compartment is not captive. If the screw is lost when the batteries are being changed, the cover of the battery compartment could be removed easily. If a child puts them in the mouth, the batteries can overheat and release electrolyte which can be ingested by the child and cause damage to the gastrointestinal tract.
description: Character toy electric tricycle, battery operated, with LEDs on wheels and on the propeller. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with European standards EN 62115 and EN 71-1.
remedy: Warning Consumers Of Risks; Removal From Online Marketplace

title: Pyrotechnic Articles: Destroyer
hazard: Asphyxiation, Burns, Damage_To_Sight, Injuries. The fireworks may burst or release burning material over an extended period of time after functioning. The user might reignite the product, which may result in the user being hit by the pyrotechnical effects and matter from the product. This can lead to injuries, burns and damage to sight. The user may bring the product inside and it may release burning material in the building. Consequently, this poses a risk of asphyxiation.
description: Battery with 100 shots. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Pyrotechnic Directive nor the European standard EN 15947-5.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Solar Panel Wiring May Be Loose
hazard: A loose wire may increase the risk of a fire.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Pause travel trailers. The incorrect connector was used to secure the 12 volt solar panel wires.
remedy: Dealers will install a new connector, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 28, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-535-2748. Forest River's number for this recall is 426-2107.

title: Electrical Appliances: Car battery trickle charger
hazard: Electric_Shock. The product lacks adequate insulation, which may cause metal parts to become insufficiently protected. As a result, the user could touch accessible live parts and receive an electric shock.
description: Intelligent car battery charger. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standards EN 60335-1 and EN 60335-2-29.

title: Machinery: Yongkang MinRui Electric Tool Plant 21V Cordless Drill Driver Kit
hazard: Electric_Shock. The power supply adaptor does not meet the dimensional requirements and is not supplied with a fuse. The creepage and clearance distances between the primary and secondary circuits are inadequate. Moreover, the product could break down over time, causing accessible metal parts to become live. The user could touch live parts and receive an electric shock.
description: Black and red electric combi drill with 21v battery and charger in a black plastic carry case. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.
remedy: Import Rejected At Border; Destruction Of Product
country: United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland

title: Electrical Appliances: Dual USB Charger Kit
hazard: Electric_Shock. The product lacks adequate insulation between the primary and secondary circuits. The USB ports and the connected cable can become live under mains voltage. Consequently, the user may receive an electric shock.
description: White mains USB charger with two USB-A ports, integrated EU plug, and a charging cable. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 60335-1.
remedy: Product Recall From Consumers; Product Withdrawal From Market

title: Electrical Appliances: Dual USB-C Charger
hazard: Electric_Shock. The product lacks adequate insulation between the primary and secondary circuits. The USB ports and the connected cable can become live under mains voltage. Consequently, the user may receive an electric shock.
description:
White plastic USB charger with two USB-C outports. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage
Directive nor with the European standard EN 60335-1.
remedy: Destruction Of Product; Product Recall From Consumers; Product Withdrawal From Market; Ban Marketing Of Product

title: Electrical Appliances: 3 USB Charger
hazard: Electric_Shock. The creepage and clearance distances between the primary and secondary side in the “safety extra low voltage” (SELV) transformer of the product are inadequate. Live parts of the product may become accessible to the user which may result in an electric shock.
description: USB phone charger with 3 USB Type-A outports. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 62368-1.

title: Toys: Toy wand
hazard: Chemical, Choking. The screw that secures the battery compartment is not captive. If the screw is lost when the batteries are being changed, the cover of the battery compartment could be removed easily. A child could put the button batteries in the mouth, which could cause gastrointestinal injuries or lead to choking.
description: Light stick made of blue transparent plastic with a button to switch on the LEDs. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with European standard EN 62115.
remedy: Product Withdrawal From Market; Destruction Of Product; Product Recall From Consumers
